Name: Pac-Man Fruit Ghosts
Author: cryomancer199x
Description:
This is a big update/overhaul for Fruit Ghosts so I'm redoing this description. Firstly, if you are using [b]any version before 4, unfortunately you will likely need to delete your old ghost house / ghosts if updating and buy new ones.[/b] Sorry. Hopefully this update is worth it though.

So this mod primarily adds several Pac-Man inspired Fruit Ghosts that will live in a Neon Ghost House and make fruit for you. It's essentially an alternative to fruit trees. If they like you, they may produce a second fruit which can be a bit more varied, forage and crops and such. Each color = two potential fruits. The graphics are edited from Pac-Man Arrangement (1996). Sprites were ripped by Techokami on Spriter's Resource

[b][size=4]Version 5[/size][/b] adds a bunch of new content for the mod.

There are now [b]5 crops[/b] instead of 1, with a bit of progression. All crops have a handful of new recipes to make with them (unlocked via levelling up), and some of those will give you new buffs. There's a [b]new ghost[/b] that produces one of the new crops, available after you've shipped one. There's several new furniture items, still gonna have to just spawn those in with Cheat Menu though. Transparent ghosts is now a mod option you can set in-game (will need to sleep for change most likely). Ghost Meat is enabled now if you have AHM, can be cooked and then also turned into a sandwich.


optional addons:
animal husbandry support (feeding treats will probably give a minor graphic error but should work, nothing i can fix on my end)

[/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/36187]Pac-Man Fruit Ghosts for Cornucopia[/url][/color]

Suggested mods to use alongside this one:[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7098]
[/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23488]Precise Furniture
[/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29997]Livestock Bazaar[/url]

thanks you to a nice anonymous person on discord for the crop sprites

as always this mod is not particularly balanced or tested heavily so if anything seems broken lemme know. i didn't make new files for the monochrome fences, if anyone really wants that let me know and i'll get back to it.

future updates?
I've got a few features unfinished yet, but this seemed like a good place to stop for the moment.
I want to make a furniture catalog.
I want to reskin all the barn items yet but it's not done, sorry. Auto-petter is giving me trouble.
Also want to make the bubblegum dispenser actually give you gumballs but it currently doesn't.
potentially other mods could get fruit ghosts, but i'm not sure which would be worth it. if you have a good suggestion leave a comment, or if you really want it to happen, check my addons out and make your own! Can help if there are questions.
